text: ok /hand-over and then we need to still fix loop cut. if i do 4 cuts horizontal and then 1 cut vertical on the last piece, it is cutting like it is for a 5th slice of vertical even tho its the first of a new face
resolution: Fixed the cross-face loop-cut direction/offset bug. Root cause was UI offset bookkeeping in Studio.tsx: the loop-cut popup seeded 'offset' once at open for Direction 0, and switching Direction to the perpendicular in-plane axis kept that stale offset. lcAxisInfo already recomputes axis/span per dir, but after 4 horizontal (X) cuts the selected sub-face is ~1 unit wide on X yet still 16 units tall on Y, so an offset of ~1 applied to the 16-unit Y axis placed the 'first' vertical cut at the top edge — reading as the 5th slice of an ongoing vertical sequence instead of a centered cut. Fix: in the LoopCutPopup onChange, when patch.dir changes the axis, re-center the offset on the new axis (round(info.sizeUnits/2), or 50 in percent mode) in the same setLc update, so the live preview and Apply both use the centered value. The pure ops (loopCutRange/loopCutPositions) were already correct given a right offset. Added a headless editMesh test reproducing '4 cuts on X then 1 on Y lands centered (halves at +/-0.5)': editMesh 27/27, modelStream 6/6 regression-clean. Updated the PLAYBOOK build log and project_studio_mesh_editor memory. TSX-only, hot-reloadable.
